# Pranauv Shrinaath S

> Pranauv Shrinaath S (known as Keni) is a founder and systems engineer in Chennai, India. CEO & Founder of NorthWind Cipher. Former intern at the National University of Singapore.

## Who is Pranauv Shrinaath?

Pranauv Shrinaath S, known as Keni, is a founder and systems engineer obsessed with building difficult technical systems from scratch. His work spans distributed systems, operating systems, networking, modern and post-quantum cryptography, trusted execution environments (TEEs), confidential computing, quantum computing and AI infrastructure. He has built 60+ projects including his own operating system, programming language and compiler. He is currently CEO & Founder of NorthWind Cipher, which builds verifiable infrastructure for AI systems. He is a former intern at the National University of Singapore (Big Data & Deep Learning) and studies B.Tech Computer Science (AI & ML) at SRM Institute of Science and Technology (graduating 2028, CGPA 9.14/10).
